text: A grid that kills fifty when it stumbles was built wrong. Somebody has to make that legible.
style: Critical Mass field lieutenant, a former grid engineer in his mid-forties. Speak with a consistent South African English (Johannesburg) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, flat pitch; slow, clipped pace. Detached and contemptuous, barely looking up from his laptop; nothing anyone says is new to him.
